plan.title: Integration Tests + Verification Suite

task.description: Create test infrastructure: conftest.py with fixtures for real PostgreSQL test database (create/drop per session), async database session fixture, httpx AsyncClient fixture pointing at FastAPI test app, test user factory (admin + regular user), test vault directory setup/teardown. pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] with asyncio_mode = "auto". No @pytest.mark.asyncio decorators. Docker Compose test file for spinning up PostgreSQL in CI.
task.verification: pytest discovers tests. Test database created/destroyed per session. Fixtures provide authenticated client instances for admin and regular user.
task.done-condition: pytest --co lists all test files, fixtures work, test DB lifecycle clean

task.description: Create auth integration tests: test_auth.py — full auth flow: register first admin → login → verify JWT → refresh token → change password → login with new password. must_change_password flag enforcement. Subsequent register blocked (403). Session creation and revocation. Non-admin 403 on admin endpoints. Create RLS isolation tests: test_rls.py — create two users (Alice, Bob). Alice creates documents, conversations, memories. Bob queries same tables → sees zero of Alice's private data. Both see shared namespace content. Verify SET/RESET cycle: after request, connection has no app.current_user_id set.
task.verification: All auth flow tests pass. RLS isolation proven: user A cannot see user B's private data. Shared data visible to both. No RLS context leak between requests.
task.done-condition: Auth flow tests cover all 9 endpoints. RLS tests prove complete isolation across all RLS-protected tables. Zero false positives.

task.description: Create watcher + parser tests: test_vault.py — VaultRegistry resolves private/shared/unknown paths correctly. Registry refreshes after user creation. test_parser.py — parser extracts frontmatter (YAML with type, tags, title), wikilinks ([[target]], [[target|alias]]), body content. NoteTypeClassifier infers correctly from frontmatter, folder, tags, defaults. test_indexer.py — file create → document record in DB with correct content_hash, note_type, wikilinks. File modify → record updated. File delete → record removed. Debounce prevents double processing. test_docker.py — Docker smoke test: build image, start container, GET /health returns 200 with setup_required=true, create admin, GET /health returns setup_required=false.
task.verification: All vault/parser/indexer tests pass. Docker smoke test passes. Edge cases covered: empty files, files without frontmatter, nested wikilinks, unicode filenames.
task.done-condition: VaultRegistry, parser, NoteTypeClassifier, indexer, and Docker container all verified via automated tests
